_comment: Synthetic PACS/RIS fixture data for FixturePacsRisAdapter. All patient identifiers, names, and content below are fabricated for testing only - none of this is real patient data. Field names mirror the internal DTO shape (see packages/shared-types/src/pacs-ris.ts), not raw source column names, to keep the fixture close to what fetchReports() should return. Converged to the read-only display field set (issue #26): no workflow status, sex, age, or inpatient number.
